title: RoboGen: Towards Unleashing Infinite Data for Automated Robot Learning via Generative Simulation — source-layout editable reconstruction

provenance.paper_title: RoboGen: Towards Unleashing Infinite Data for Automated Robot Learning via Generative Simulation
provenance.license: http://arxiv.org/licenses/nonexclusive-distrib/1.0/ Private user-requested adaptation; no public redistribution permission implied.
provenance.notes: Manually reconstructed from the inspected original flattened PDF figure. Ordinary labels are live typeable text; panels, graph geometry and arrows are native editable shapes or paths. Source layout and contents retained; font metrics, line widths and decorative effects approximated. Initialization asset icons, scene photographs and each skill thumbnail are separate original raster crops. All stage headings, task-example cards, models, configuration blocks, dataset labels, reward labels and main routing paths are native typeable/editable objects.
provenance.visual_inspection: Original PDF figure inspected before source-layout reconstruction on 2026-10-09; independent application QA pending.
